flagship.name: SATRK
flagship.tagline: One step ahead of every scam.
flagship.type: End-to-end cyber defense system for SIH 2026
flagship.purpose: SATRK is an end-to-end cyber defense system built for Smart India Hackathon (SIH) 2026 to help detect and respond to modern Indian telecommunication and financial scams, especially digital arrest and authority impersonation scams.
problem_areas: Police / CBI / Cyber Cell / Supreme Court impersonation
Bank account / UPI / KYC blockade threats
AI voice cloning / deepfake voice scams
flagship.core_pipeline: Android App (TelephonyManager / CALL_STATE_OFFHOOK / AudioRecord) -> PCM Audio over WebSocket -> FastAPI WebSocket Router -> STT Service using Groq Whisper (whisper-large-v3) -> Indian-language speech to English translation -> Parallel Analysis (Rule Engine + Groq LLM contextual reasoning + Resemble AI voice-clone detection) -> Unified Event Stream -> Dashboard UI.
flagship.multilingual_capability: Supports Indian multilingual speech analysis during live call audio processing, including Hindi, Marathi, Gujarati, and Hinglish. Groq Whisper (whisper-large-v3) translates speech into structured English text with RMS silence filtering, regex post-filtering, and repetitive-token detection.
flagship.scam_reasoning: Combines a deterministic Rule Engine (regex/keyword signals) and Groq LLM contextual reasoning (openai/gpt-oss-20b prompt-engineered for Indian scam typologies). Produces SAFE, WARNING, or SCAM verdicts with percentage risk score, detected scam signals, and defensive advice.
flagship.voice_deepfake_detection: Voice authenticity analysis powered by Resemble AI API is activated when call risk reaches THREAT_THRESHOLD >= 50.0. If a possible voice clone is detected, a possible_voice_clone signal is added and overall risk score is boosted by +10%. Not every call is automatically deepfake-verified.
flagship.malicious_link_scanner: Scans URLs extracted from SMS/chat messages using Google Safe Browsing API v4 across threat categories: MALWARE, SOCIAL_ENGINEERING, UNWANTED_SOFTWARE, and POTENTIALLY_HARMFUL_APPLICATION.
flagship.performance_architecture: Designed as a low-latency asynchronous pipeline with parallel AI processing (AsyncGroq, httpx.AsyncClient, asyncio.gather) and strict 3.5-second upstream timeouts for external AI calls with graceful degradation to Rule Engine results. Audio is streamed only during active calls.
flagship.feedback_loop: Human-in-the-loop Yes/No feedback mechanism on high-risk alerts logged to refine rule weights, prompt calibration, and detection behavior (model is not automatically retrained per event).
flagship.ritesh_role: Ritesh Chaudhari served as the Lead AI Engineer, Cybersecurity Developer, and System Architect for SATRK. He designed the low-latency WebSocket PCM audio streaming pipeline, integrated Groq Whisper (whisper-large-v3) STT with RMS silence and repetition filtering, built the dual-engine scam reasoning system (Rule Engine + Groq LLM), implemented Resemble AI voice deepfake detection, and integrated Google Safe Browsing URL scanning.
engineering_challenges: Android VOICE_CALL recording restrictions: Bypassed using TelephonyManager (CALL_STATE_OFFHOOK) and microphone PCM AudioRecord streaming strictly during active calls.
Whisper STT hallucination & repetition loops: Eliminated using RMS silence threshold filtering and regex post-processing.
Upstream API stalls/timeouts: Solved by implementing strict 3.5s timeouts with asyncio.gather parallel execution and graceful fallback to deterministic Rule Engine.
Code-switched Indian speech: Accurately transcribed and translated Indian multilingual speech (Hindi, Marathi, Gujarati, Hinglish) into structured English scam signals.
User Privacy & Security: Audio is streamed ephemerally over WebSockets only during active calls without persistent raw audio recording.
